text:
alex_k: heads up, apac-pool-3 is seeing a weird cluster of ECC correctable spikes on a handful of cards over the last 12m. not showing Xid but perf is degraded on several pods. :rotating_light:

samir: saw the alert. visibility shows 4 cards with bursts: card ids g1,g4,g7,g9. errors come in short bursts ~30-90s, then quiet. no obvious thermal alarms in the host logs.

maria_ops: are these hosts part of the maintenance window? we had a BMC firmware push earlier this morning to that rack, could be flapping. tagging @infra-automation to check recent jobs.

infra-automation: job 2026-03-18-03:12:21 targeted apac-rack-12 BMC firmware rollout completed at 03:14:02. no failures recorded. note: rack power cycling job ran at 03:16:10, operator-triggered.

alex_k: interesting — spikes started ~03:20. potential correlation with that manual power cycle. could be card reseat/slot contact issues after power event.

jessica: quick triage plan: 1) run nvml diagnostic on the 4 GPUs, 2) soft-requeue pods pinned to those cards, 3) if errors resume within 10m post-requeue -> soft-quarantine the GPU (no new pods), 4) if still noisy after 2 soft-quarantines -> schedule replacement.

samir: agreed. adding a small heuristic proposal: compute a burst_score using an EWMA over corrected ECC events. something like:

```
# burst scoring (pseudocode)
alpha = 0.3
ewma_t = alpha * errs_this_min + (1-alpha) * ewma_prev
burst_score = ewma_t / baseline_err_rate
if burst_score > 4 and errs_this_min >= 5:
    trigger_soft_quarantine()
```

This avoids single-tone blips but catches repeated short bursts.

oncall-bot: running diagnostic checklist: nvmlDeviceGetEccErrors, dmesg filters, and nv-hostengine status. executing now for g1,g4,g7,g9. will post results. :gear: 

oncall-bot: nvml ecc summary: g1(CEC: 12 corr in 10m), g4(8), g7(2), g9(11). dmesg shows repeated PCIe AER corrected errors on g1/g9. nv-hostengine reports no obvious H/W faults.

maria_ops: PCIe AER corrected errors often mean link retrain after power events. we should isolate host NIC/cabling and re-run `ethtool -S` + `lspci -vvv` to confirm link state. also bumping soft-quarantine threshold for this rack to be more aggressive sounds reasonable.

alex_k: doing soft requeue on nodes now: cordon -> drain with --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data, then let autoscaler reschedule. posting drain commands:

```
kubectl cordon node/apac-r12-n3
kubectl drain node/apac-r12-n3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='gpu==g1'
```

samir: after requeue, let's watch for 10m. if corrected errors fall to baseline (<1/min) we unquarantine, otherwise mark cards as suspect and trigger a replace ticket. jessica will own the replace if needed.

jessica: ok I'll prepare an asset-replace ticket template and a short checklist for on-site tech: reseat card, check riser, run local nvml stress test 15m, replace if noise persists. adding steps to ops-runbook under "apac-rack-12 ECC post-power-cycle".

infra-automation: created runbook PR (#452) with the checklist and the burst_score algorithm. also created an alert variant `ecc.burst_score` with a 10m evaluation window and muted for 5m after automated soft-quarantine to avoid flapping.

alex_k: a few followups: 1) Can we add a telemetry tag on these GPUs so we can filter historical events for other post-power-cycle windows? 2) Agree we should not auto-replace on first occurrence; prefer 2 soft-quarantine cycles within 24h before replacement.

samir: +1. telemetry tag idea: add a label `last-power-event=2026-03-18T03:16Z` on the host and correlate with ECC events in Grafana. I'll add a quick dashboard panel for "ECC per power-event".

maria_ops: also recommend a temporary capacity hedge for apac region while we triage (spin up 2 extra nodes in apac-pool-4) so customer traffic unaffected. I'll file a short-term capacity request.

jessica: leaving checklist here for on-site: 1) reseat riser 2) swap PCIe slot 3) run `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` 4) nvml-stress 15m 5) replace if persistent. I'll copy to ticket.

oncall-bot: monitoring window started. will post an update at +10m and +30m.

alex_k: thanks team. if the burst_score triggers and infra-automation quarantine action runs, I'll coordinate replacement scheduling with jessica and ops. keeping this thread for updates only. :thumbsup:
